Scheduled, but it is not reliable yet, and I made two mistakes you should know about.

- **Not running:** the job is saved (ID 93840835c301), but the Hermes gateway isn't running, so it won't fire until the gateway is started.
- **Wrong first run:** the scheduler reports the next run as Mon 26 Oct 17:30 UTC. Today's 17:30 Chicago time is 22:30 UTC on Wed 14 Oct, so the first run would be skipped. The scheduler appears to read "17:30" as UTC. I haven't changed it, because a fixed UTC cron would drift by an hour when US daylight time ends on 1 Nov. Tell me if you want me to switch to that anyway.
- **Channel post:** I posted a status note in #strategic-pod's thread under your message. It included a line saying I was "checking" the timing, which I'm not doing, and it exposed scheduler details to the whole pod. I have no tool to delete it, so it stays up until someone removes it.

The job is set to post to #strategic-pod only, and it reads only that channel. It also omits money figures, as the rules require.
